description: North Central Provincial Council - Order to delegate the power of Co-operative Societies Act. to K. M. K. Jayalath w.e.f. 20.06.2017
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Susil Gunarathna, Provincial Minister) and detailed descriptions of the powers and responsibilities being delegated (specific sections of the Co-operative Societies Act and Co-operative Code of Regulation). It includes both "who" (the government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
